title: CPT tweaks
description: A customizable Totem Slot Manager for Crystal PvP. Automatically keeps a Totem of Undying in a selected inventory slot, featuring an easy-to-use GUI, configurable cooldowns, and optional offhand support.
body:
Slot Manager

> A lightweight Crystal PvP utility mod that automatically keeps a Totem of Undying in your selected inventory slot.

---

## ✨ Features

### 🎯 Custom Slot Selection
Choose any inventory slot that should always contain a Totem of Undying.

### ⚡ Automatic Refill
When your selected slot becomes empty, the mod automatically refills it from available Totems in your inventory.

### 🖥️ User-Friendly GUI
Configure everything through an easy-to-use graphical interface.

✔ Select target slots directly from the menu  
✔ View your inventory layout  
✔ Quick and simple configuration  

### ⏱️ Adjustable Cooldown
Set a custom delay between automatic refills to match your preferences.

### 📦 Inventory Pause
Pause automatic refilling while interacting with inventory screens.

### 🛡️ Crystal PvP Optimized
Built specifically for Crystal PvP players who want fast and reliable access to Totems during combat.

### 🔧 Optional Offhand Support
An optional offhand mode is available for advanced users.

# 🚨 IMPORTANT SERVER WARNING 🚨

## Offhand Mode May Not Be Allowed on Many Servers

⚠️ The optional Offhand Mode automatically moves Totems to your offhand.

⚠️ Many PvP, Crystal PvP, Practice, and Survival servers do not allow automatic inventory or offhand management.

⚠️ Some servers may consider this feature to be Auto Totem or an unfair combat advantage.

⚠️ Depending on the server's rules, using Offhand Mode may result in warnings, temporary punishments, or permanent bans.

⚠️ Even if a server does not explicitly ban this feature, staff members may still consider it unfair or against the spirit of the game.

### Please Note

Before enabling Offhand Mode, always check the server's rules and ensure that such modifications are allowed.

**Use this feature at your own risk.**

The standard inventory slot management features are generally less controversial, but server policies can vary.

---
---

## 💡 Why Use Totem Slot Manager?

During intense Crystal PvP fights, manually moving Totems can waste valuable time.

Totem Slot Manager automatically keeps your chosen slot stocked with Totems whenever possible, allowing you to focus on combat instead of inventory management.

---

## 🚀 Benefits

🟢 Lightweight and optimized

🟢 Easy configuration

🟢 Crystal PvP focused

🟢 Automatic inventory management

🟢 Customizable settings

🟢 Modern GUI

---

## 📌 Important

The mod can only refill your selected slot if additional Totems are available somewhere in your inventory.

If no Totems are available, the slot cannot be refilled.
